## Projects

### ProjectLens

- Shelf: Products
- Status: Public
- Problem: Change packs and schedules disagree quietly before board meetings
- Outcome: Compares the pack with the schedule and records the decision
- Proof: Browser-local Northstar demo on bundled synthetic fixtures; Playwright checks in CI
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=projectlens
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/ProjectLens
- Stack: Python, Playwright, pandas, GitHub Pages

### Output Gate

- Shelf: Products
- Status: Public
- Problem: Prompt and model changes quietly reintroduce known output failures
- Outcome: Checks saved outputs against required and banned phrases
- Proof: Deterministic, in the browser or as a GitHub Action; no model call
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=ai-evaluator
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/ai-workflow-evaluator
- Stack: Python, GitHub Actions, HTML, JavaScript

### MeetingProof

- Shelf: Products
- Status: Public
- Problem: Meeting follow-ups lose the link back to what was said
- Outcome: Drafts decisions, actions and questions you approve before export
- Proof: Browser demo on synthetic notes; nothing exports without approval
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=meetingproof
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/MeetingProof
- Stack: JavaScript, LangGraph, Pydantic, GitHub Pages

### Paper Trading Research Engine

- Shelf: Data systems
- Status: Public
- Problem: Backtest results are easy to cherry-pick and hard to reproduce
- Outcome: Walk-forward backtests with provenance-bundled reports
- Proof: Published benchmark numbers are labelled synthetic fixtures, not market performance
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=paper-trading
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/paper-trading-bot
- Stack: Python, pandas, GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages

### Happening

- Shelf: Automation
- Status: Private
- Problem: Venue listings are scattered and unreliable
- Outcome: Turns venue pages into checked event data
- Proof: 129 configs and 1,130 tests private; open-core benchmark public in CI
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=happening-core
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/happening-open-core
- Stack: Python, Playwright, SQLite, Pydantic, GitHub Actions

### PySpark Kafka Streaming

- Shelf: Data systems
- Status: Public
- Problem: Streaming examples are often too big to actually read
- Outcome: Compact PySpark and Kafka examples that run
- Proof: CI executes the DataFrame demo via spark-submit
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=pyspark
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/pyspark-kafka-streaming
- Stack: Python, PySpark, Kafka, Docker

### Can England Win It

- Shelf: Archive
- Status: Archived
- Problem: Single-event tools go stale after the event
- Outcome: A 10,000-run scenario simulator, archived with a postmortem
- Proof: Seed-deterministic tests; POSTMORTEM.md explains the archive decision
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=england
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/can-england-win-it
- Stack: TypeScript, React, Vite, Vitest

### QuickSupply

- Shelf: Products
- Status: Private
- Problem: School cover coordination becomes a spreadsheet-and-message chain
- Outcome: Coordinates school cover end to end
- Proof: 24k-line Next.js app; 14 migrations, SSE, 12 Playwright e2e suites
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=quicksupply
- Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, SSE
